summary.prose: Building this Story gives every model-judged code-review dimension a divided path on top of s1's pipeline and s2's material. Each dimension states what it must judge (obligations with their context), reads chunks with prompts that can only take notes or chunk-local findings, and adjudicates every obligation once on the notes from all chunks. Quality and adherence check calls that cross chunks, and quality compares symbol descriptions across chunks to find duplicates. The merged result folds into today's DimensionResult and verdict. The Story ends by updating the installed daemon and running Epic c2ba6fa6 Story s1's code review, which was refused for size, as the acceptance smoke.

tasks.title: Obligations and context atoms per code-review dimension
tasks.summary: In src/workflow/review-pipeline/code-review.ts (and a new src/workflow/review-pipeline/adapters/code-review-obligations.ts), each model dimension's material() adds obligations and context built from the saved subject and the snapshot only. adherence: one 'clause' obligation per approved LLD clause (keys derived deterministically from the LLD body: each contractDetails entry, dataModelChanges entry, errorPaths case and invariant) and one per PLAN task (its task id), each clause's text a context atom the obligation names; none and no call without an approved LLD or plan (today's skip). functional coverage: one 'requirement' per FR (functionalRequirementsOf). coverage: one 'promised-test' per promised test (promisedTestsOf), its context ALL the record evidence testRecordView gives for that test chosen by name (reportedTests entry, build tasks, record notes, status and title atoms of every test file naming it), also with empty grounding. conventions: one 'module-conventions' per touched module (the atoms' module values). quality: none.
acceptanceChecks: Each dimension's obligation set equals what today's single prompt asks the model to judge: LLD clauses and PLAN tasks, FRs, promised tests, touched modules; quality has none.
Adherence has no obligations and makes no call without an approved LLD or plan, as today.
A promised test passed only by a reported smoke or live run, with no test file or reaching edge, has that reported result in its obligation context; this holds with empty grounding.
Obligations and context are built from the saved subject and the snapshot only, and are identical on every rebuild.

tasks.title: Notes-only chunk stage for adherence, functional coverage and conventions
tasks.summary: The 'judge' stage of adherence, functional coverage and conventions gets chunkCalls(chunk, prior, snapshot): one structured call in the repository over the chunk's rows (the s2 atoms, in today's array form), its neighbour lines and the context atoms the chunk needs, with today's framing. The answer schema is notes only, [{ key, atomIds, note }], with NO findings field: the note records how the chunk's code realises, partly realises or departs from the obligation (for conventions, idiom examples and candidate deviations seen in the module). validate(answer, call) rejects an unknown note key and an atomId outside call.carries.atomIds; withCorrection re-issues with the reasons; gather.notesFrom reads the keyed notes. The single path keeps today's prompt and schema.
acceptanceChecks: The adherence, functional-coverage and conventions chunk schemas have no findings field, so no chunk answer can record an absence finding, an obligation verdict or a conventions verdict.

A chunk answer with an unknown key or an atom outside its call's carries is rejected and re-issued once with a correction note, then fails the review. The reasons have a fixed size (a made-up value is located by count and position, never quoted back); when a call already fills the limit and leaves no room for the correction, it is re-issued as planned with the omission logged, as s1's approved LLD rules (src/workflow/review-pipeline/job.ts), and a second invalid answer still fails the review.
Every chunk call measures within the limit with its rows, neighbour lines and context atoms.
Under the limit s1's single path sends today's prompt and schema unchanged.

tasks.title: Chunk stage for coverage and quality
tasks.summary: Coverage's 'judge' stage gets chunkCalls returning symbol-coverage findings only (findingKind 'symbol-coverage', each with a symbolId the call carries) plus notes per promised test; quality's returns today's findings plus descriptions [{ atomId, description }], one per carried atom. validate(answer, call) rejects a coverage finding that is not symbol coverage of a carried symbol, a note key or atom outside the call, and a quality description set not equal to the carried atoms (missing, repeated or foreign ids named in the reasons); withCorrection re-issues with the reasons. The single path keeps today's prompts and schemas.
acceptanceChecks: A coverage chunk finding that is not symbol coverage of a carried symbol is rejected and re-issued once with a correction note, then fails the review; promised-test findings come only from gather.
A quality chunk answer carries exactly one description for every atom the call carries, and no other; a missing, repeated or foreign description is rejected, re-issued once, then fails the review.
Under the limit s1's single path sends today's coverage and quality prompts and schemas unchanged.

tasks.title: Obligation adjudication and reduction per dimension
tasks.summary: Each model dimension with obligations gets a gather plan: obligationCall(key, evidence, context) judges one key with today's rules for that dimension on all its notes and the obligation's own context atoms, returning today's findings shape (adherence: departures located at the atoms the notes name, and unimplemented clauses, with expectationRef; functional coverage: unrealized or partial FRs; coverage: missing or failing promised tests on the test's full record evidence; conventions: the module's idiom and deviations with today's too-few-examples rule). A key with no notes is judged on the statement that no chunk showed evidence for it; with zero atoms every key is judged on its context alone. reduceCall returns one note under the same key within noteCapChars (a quarter of the limit), keeping its atom ids. partOf maps an obligation answer to a DimensionResult part. Locations are governed by today's per-dimension filters in finish (t7), not by a gather validate.
acceptanceChecks: A key with no notes is adjudicated on the no-evidence statement, so a missing clause, FR or promised test is reported as one call would report it.
A conventions candidate deviation seen in one chunk that the module judgement rejects never appears in the result.
A key whose notes exceed the limit is reduced by reduceCall into notes within noteCapChars and then judged; every gather call fits the limit.
With zero atoms every promised test is judged on its full record evidence, and nothing is reported as symbol coverage.

tasks.title: Cross-chunk relation checks for quality and adherence
tasks.summary: gather.relationCall(pair, maxChars?) for the quality and adherence dimensions judges each 'calls' relation in ChunkPlan.crossRelations: one call carrying both full rows when they fit together, otherwise (or when maxChars is set after a refusal) two calls, one full row against the other's neighbour summary in each direction, each within the size. Each judges whether the caller's use matches the callee (arguments, return use, error contract; for adherence the approved clauses either carries) and returns today's findings shape with a mismatch located at the caller. gather.validate rejects a relation answer naming a counterpart or location outside its two symbols.
acceptanceChecks: A relation call carries both full rows when they fit, else full against neighbour summary in each direction, and every call fits the limit (or the reported maxChars).
A caller and callee in different chunks whose contract disagrees are judged in a relation call and the mismatch is reported at the caller.
A relation answer naming a counterpart outside its two symbols is rejected, re-issued once, then fails the review.

tasks.title: Quality's compare and pair stages for cross-chunk duplicates
tasks.summary: Quality's adapter adds model stages 'compare' and 'pair' after its chunk stage, onCallFailure 'fail-review', run only when the plan is divided. s1 issues every later stage per chunk, so compare's chunkCalls for chunk i packs the chunk's descriptions (from the chunk stage's output) into batches of at most half the limit and pairs each with the batches of every later chunk; each call returns candidate duplicate pairs. pair's chunkCalls for chunk i judges each candidate pair whose first symbol chunk i holds, on both full rows when they fit together, else full against description in each direction, returning today's quality findings with counterpartRef; validate rejects a counterpart outside the pair. Both stages set countAs: 'relation' (s1's AdapterStage.countAs, added by the stakeholder's decision of 2026-10-20), so their calls are counted under pipelineCalls.relation as the LLD's data-model note says, while keeping role 'chunk' for retry and re-division.
acceptanceChecks: Every two symbols in different chunks are compared through their descriptions, in calls that each fit the limit.
Two duplicate symbols in different chunks are named by compare and reported by pair with counterpartRef.
A pair answer naming a counterpart outside its two symbols is rejected, re-issued once, then fails the review.
Under the limit no compare or pair call is made.
Every compare and pair call, re-issues and re-divisions included, is counted under pipelineCalls.relation (countAs: 'relation'), not under chunk.

tasks.title: Merge and finish into today's DimensionResult
tasks.summary: Each model dimension's finish handles a divided review (replacing today's 'dividing a code review is not available yet' error): the chunk results (coverage symbol findings, quality findings and pair findings) in stage order; gather.merge concatenates them with the obligation and relation parts, keeps identical findings once, expands a finding naming a note id to that note's atoms through the job's provenance, and applies each dimension's existing result filters: today's changed-set filter on the daemon path (findings outside it dropped, as today), functional coverage's known-FR expectationRef filter, and normalizeCoverageFindings run once over coverage's merged result with the prepared grounding. On the controller path out-of-set findings still reach the step handler's outOfScope handling (src/daemon/steps/code-review-step/handler.ts) as today. pipelineCalls is set by s1 and absent on a single-chunk review; runCodeReview folds with foldVerdict unchanged.

Out-of-set findings are dropped on the daemon path and kept in outOfScope on the controller path, as today.
A functional-coverage finding with an unknown expectationRef at a valid changed-file location is dropped by finish, as today.
pipelineCalls counts the divided review's calls per role and is absent on a single-chunk review.

feedback.author: Subho Ghosh
feedback.comment: Amended 2026-10-20 by the stakeholder's decision after t2's third build gate. t2's check required a correction note on every re-issue, which conflicts with s1's approved rule: prepare lets one symbol fill the hard limit, and a correction that does not fit beside such a call is left out and logged, never cut. The check now follows s1: the reasons have a fixed size (a made-up value is located by count and position, never quoted back), so the correction is sent whenever the call has room; a call that already fills the limit is re-issued as planned with the omission logged, and a second invalid answer still fails the review. Also recorded: commit 581e1d76 (a t2 fix) changed quality's description reasons to the same fixed-size form for consistency, since every chunk validator lives in one module; that part belongs to t3's surface.
